IS 17403 : 2020 Magnalium for Explosives and Pyrotechnic Composition-Specification
ICS 71.060.20; 71.100.30
CHD 26
New Standard from Last Update.
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes requirements, methods of sampling and methods of test for magnalium powder (magnesium-aluminium 50 : 50 alloy powder) for use in explosive and pyrotechnic composition.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed below contain provisions which though reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of the standards listed below:
